name: Postaxial Polydactyly Type A

ethnicAssociations: Higher prevalence in African and African-American populations

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Clinical Diagnostic Criteria for Postaxial Polydactyly Type A

criteria.description: Presence of a well-formed extra digit on the ulnar side of the hand or fibular side of the foot
Extra digit has articulating bones (phalanges and metacarpal/metatarsal elements)
Positive family history of postaxial polydactyly type A or autosomal dominant inheritance pattern

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Presence of a well-formed extra digit with articulating bones on the postaxial side of a hand or foot
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Genetic testing may support diagnosis but is not mandatory; differentiation from type B polydactyly is essential.
